entry.title: New: Resolution 480 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 480-26 & FC-132 - 04/08/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH NEOGOV FOR SOFTWARE LICENSING, MAINTENANCE, AND SUPPORT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN RESOURCES

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a three-year agreement with an approximate annual cost of $34,100 for the first year, $36,570 for the second year, and $39,230 for the third year, to provide software licensing, maintenance, and support for the department’s Recruitment and Examination Division.
